title: syzygium rugosum var. cordatum
intro: Syzygium rugosum var. cordatum, commonly known as Waterberry or Water Cherry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Syzygium rugosum var. cordatum include its ability to stimulate diuresis, making it a potential treatment for urinary disorders and edema. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
